intent: Add star, fork, issue, release-download and package-download marts; legacy change columns; snapshot key on declared grain

edits.new_content:
with daily as (
    select *, cast(captured_at at time zone 'UTC' as date) as date
    from {{ ref('stg_observations') }}
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by repository, cast(captured_at at time zone 'UTC' as date) order by captured_at desc
    ) = 1
), changes as (
    select *, lag(date) over w as previous_date,
           lag(stars) over w as previous_stars, lag(forks) over w as previous_forks
    from daily
    window w as (partition by repository order by date)
)
select md5(repository || '|' || cast(date as varchar)) as observation_key,
       repository, date, captured_at, stars, forks, watchers, open_issues_and_prs,
       date_diff('day', previous_date, date) as observation_gap_days,
       case when date_diff('day', previous_date, date) = 1 then stars - previous_stars end as stars_net_change,
       case when date_diff('day', previous_date, date) = 1 then forks - previous_forks end as forks_net_change
from changes

with balances as (
    select repository, date,
           last_value(stars ignore nulls) over w as stars,
           last_value(forks ignore nulls) over w as forks
    from {{ ref('stg_legacy') }}
    window w as (partition by repository order by date rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
)
select md5(repository || '|' || cast(date as varchar)) as legacy_key,
       repository, date, stars, forks,
       -- Change since the previous reconstructed row; the first row has no prior balance.
       stars - lag(stars) over w as stars_change,
       forks - lag(forks) over w as forks_change
from balances
window w as (partition by repository order by date)

-- The key hashes the declared grain (repository, endpoint, UTC day), not the capture instant.
select md5(repository || '|' || endpoint || '|' || cast(cast(captured_at at time zone 'UTC' as date) as varchar)) as snapshot_key,
       repository, endpoint, captured_at, cast(captured_at at time zone 'UTC' as date) as date, source_file
from {{ ref('stg_snapshots') }}
qualify row_number() over (
    partition by repository, endpoint, cast(captured_at at time zone 'UTC' as date) order by captured_at desc
) = 1

-- Dense UTC days from the first event through the last fully covered day.
-- Covered days without events are true zeros; days after coverage are absent, not zero.
with coverage as (
    select repository, complete,
           cast(captured_at at time zone 'UTC' as date) as captured_date
    from {{ ref('stg_signal_captures') }}
    where signal = 'stargazers'
), bounds as (
    select c.repository, min(e.date) as first_date,
           -- The capture day is partial; a truncated listing is complete only before its last day.
           case when c.complete then c.captured_date - 1 else max(e.date) - 1 end as last_date
    from coverage c
    join {{ ref('stg_stargazer_days') }} e on e.repository = c.repository
    group by c.repository, c.complete, c.captured_date
), days as (
    select b.repository, cast(d as date) as date
    from bounds b, lateral generate_series(b.first_date, b.last_date, interval 1 day) as dates(d)
    where b.last_date >= b.first_date
)
select md5(days.repository || '|' || cast(days.date as varchar)) as star_history_key,
       days.repository, days.date, coalesce(e.stars, 0) as stars_gained
from days
left join {{ ref('stg_stargazer_days') }} e on e.repository = days.repository and e.date = days.date

-- Dense UTC days from the first event through the last fully covered day.
-- Covered days without events are true zeros; days after coverage are absent, not zero.
with coverage as (
    select repository, complete,
           cast(captured_at at time zone 'UTC' as date) as captured_date
    from {{ ref('stg_signal_captures') }}
    where signal = 'forks'
), bounds as (
    select c.repository, min(e.date) as first_date,
           -- The capture day is partial; a truncated listing is complete only before its last day.
           case when c.complete then c.captured_date - 1 else max(e.date) - 1 end as last_date
    from coverage c
    join {{ ref('stg_fork_days') }} e on e.repository = c.repository
    group by c.repository, c.complete, c.captured_date
), days as (
    select b.repository, cast(d as date) as date
    from bounds b, lateral generate_series(b.first_date, b.last_date, interval 1 day) as dates(d)
    where b.last_date >= b.first_date
)
select md5(days.repository || '|' || cast(days.date as varchar)) as fork_history_key,
       days.repository, days.date, coalesce(e.forks, 0) as forks_created
from days
left join {{ ref('stg_fork_days') }} e on e.repository = days.repository and e.date = days.date

select md5(repository || '|' || cast(number as varchar)) as issue_key,
       repository, number, kind,
       cast(created_at at time zone 'UTC' as date) as created_date,
       cast(closed_at at time zone 'UTC' as date) as closed_date,
       cast(merged_at at time zone 'UTC' as date) as merged_date,
       author_association,
       author_association in ('FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR', 'FIRST_TIMER') as is_first_time_contributor,
       date_diff('second', created_at, merged_at) / 3600.0 as hours_to_merge
from {{ ref('stg_issues') }}

with daily as (
    select *, cast(captured_at at time zone 'UTC' as date) as date
    from {{ ref('stg_release_assets') }}
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by repository, asset_id, cast(captured_at at time zone 'UTC' as date) order by captured_at desc
    ) = 1
), changes as (
    select *, lag(date) over w as previous_date, lag(download_count) over w as previous_downloads
    from daily
    window w as (partition by repository, asset_id order by date)
)
select md5(repository || '|' || asset_id || '|' || cast(date as varchar)) as release_download_key,
       repository, event_id, asset_id, date, captured_at, download_count,
       case when date_diff('day', previous_date, date) = 1 then download_count - previous_downloads end as downloads_net_change
from changes
